name: com.retailnetwork.storefront/shopping-cart
title: Shopping Cart MCP
description: Holds a shopper's intent: cart lines, the destination postal prefix, the delivery quote delivery-promise returned for the cart (per shipment group, with its offers and expiry), the shopper's tier selection per group, and a labelled, non-binding estimate (effective prices + selected tier charges + tax band) so the total cost is visible up front.
